subject.title: feat(irc): support markdown messages via draft/multiline

question: Should bundled IRC adopt draft/multiline now, and if so what protocol-compliance and proof bar is required before this PR can merge?
rationale: The feature improves IRC readability, but it implements a work-in-progress IRCv3 extension and changes compatibility-sensitive message delivery behavior.

options.title: Repair and re-review
options.body: Require a current-main rebase plus protocol-compliant splitting, advertised limits, concat reconstruction, sanitizer scoping, and focused tests before reconsidering merge.

options.title: Narrow first landing
options.body: Sponsor outbound-only multiline support first and defer inbound BATCH reconstruction until concat and limit behavior are designed.

options.title: Pause draft adoption
options.body: Close or pause this PR until an IRC owner explicitly sponsors shipping the draft extension in bundled IRC.

recommendation.title: Repair and re-review
recommendation.body: Require a current-main rebase plus protocol-compliant splitting, advertised limits, concat reconstruction, sanitizer scoping, and focused tests before reconsidering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vignesh07 introduced the IRC channel surface and is the strongest history signal for owner-level direction.
